desc: Diving-bell spirit: lavender brass diving helmet body, tiny blue body, gold rivets, coiled fishing line. Face: one big round glass porthole eye with a white highlight, sleepy half-lid. Abstract spirit creature, no animal parts. Cute and cool chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Lavender, white, violet, gold palette. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
